name: Two-layer QG model simulation (PyQG)
size_as_stated: 15 years with a time step of 1 h (daily averaged horizontal velocity fields saved) following 5 years spin-up
resolution: Dx = Dy ~ 3.9 km, nx = ny = 256, Lx = Ly = 1000 km, daily averaged
access: The code for the PyQG model is made available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6380711, and documentation is available at https://pyqg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/. Python code for processing the GLAD and LASER drifter datasets, running the QG simulation, and estimating structure functions and spectral fluxes using regularized least squares is available at https://github.com/manuelogtzv/SF3_RLS.

scales.note: PyQG idealized 2-layer model: 1000 km x 1000 km, 256x256 grid (~3.9 km), daily output over 15 years analysis period (or 5 years in parts, 15 years duration is 4.73e8 s).
